name: Jugendzeltplatz Chieming
beschreibung: The youth campsite Chieming is located in the municipality of the same name in the Tirol district. The atmosphere is characterized by simplicity and a connection with nature. The surroundings offer, thanks to the nearby Alps, diverse opportunities for hiking and winter sports in surrounding ski areas. The landscape is a mix of mountain panoramas and lakes. The amenities include basic sanitary facilities and designated tent pitches. Guests can expect simple accommodation with direct access to outdoor activities. The accessibility of the site is via regional roads.
